channel.title: Frontier
channel.description: A short twice-daily audio walk through one landmark study — biohacking, AI, learning, cannabis, finance, and frontier tech, explained in plain language by two hosts.
channel.itunes:author: Frontier

item.title: Frontier — Friday, August 28, 2026
item.description: A Johns Hopkins pilot study staged cannabis and psilocybin sessions identically and found that a large oral dose of THC was hard for participants to tell apart from mushrooms.
